name: EA_AML_1-01
summary: This EA trades based on the Adaptive Market Level (AML) custom indicator, which uses fractal dimension analysis to create an adaptive smoothing line. It opens a buy when the AML value is inside the previous bar's range (between open and close with close > open), and opens a sell when AML is inside the range of a bearish bar. When an opposite signal occurs and use_opposite is enabled, it closes the current position and reverses.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自适应市场水平（AML）自定义指标进行交易，该指标利用分形维度分析创建自适应平滑线。当AML值处于前一根K线的开收盘区间内时，根据阳线或阴线方向开仓；启用反向交易时，收到相反信号会平仓并反转。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自适应市场水平（AML）指标，该指标通过分形维度计算自适应平滑系数alpha，对加权价格进行指数平滑，当平滑值变化超过阈值时更新AML线，否则保持前值。入场条件为：当无持仓时，若AML值位于前一根阳线的开盘价与收盘价之间则买入，若位于前一根阴线的开收盘之间则卖出。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数，同时在启用反向交易时，若当前持多单且出现卖出信号则平多开空，反之亦然。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于余额与最大回撤比例的自适应手数计算两种模式。资金管理方面，自适应手数模式下按账户余额与最大回撤比值乘以基础手数来计算，并设有最大手数限制。止损止盈在开仓后通过多次尝试修改订单来设置，最多尝试N_modify_sltp次。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Adaptive Market Level (AML) indicator, which calculates an adaptive smoothing coefficient alpha using fractal dimension analysis, applies exponential smoothing to a weighted price, and updates the AML line when the smoothed value change exceeds a threshold, otherwise holding the previous value. Entry conditions: when no position exists, a buy is opened if the AML value lies between the open and close of the previous bullish bar, and a sell is opened if it lies between the open and close of a bearish bar. Exit conditions rely on hardcoded SL/TP values in points, and when opposite trading is enabled, the current position is closed and reversed upon receiving a contrary signal. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and an adaptive mode that scales lot size proportionally to account balance divided by a maximum drawdown parameter. Money management in adaptive mode calculates lot size as base lots multiplied by account balance divided by max drawdown, with a cap at the symbol's maximum volume. Stop loss and take profit are set after order placement via repeated modification attempts up to N_modify_sltp times with 1-second sleep between retries.

parameters.name: N_modify_sltp
parameters.description: 修改止损止盈最大尝试次数
parameters.description_en: Max retry attempts for SL/TP modification

parameters.name: use_opposite
parameters.description: 是否启用反向信号平仓反手
parameters.description_en: Enable reverse signal close and reverse position

parameters.name: use_Multpl
parameters.description: 是否启用自适应手数模式

parameters.name: Max_drawdown
parameters.description: 自适应手数模式的最大回撤参考值
parameters.description_en: Max drawdown reference for adaptive lot mode

pros: 使用分形维度自适应平滑，指标能根据市场波动性自动调节灵敏度
支持反向信号平仓反手，可在趋势转变时及时调整仓位方向
提供自适应手数模式，根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小
止损止盈修改有重试机制，提高了订单修改的成功率
仅在新K线开盘时执行交易逻辑，避免逐tick重复计算
pros_en: Uses fractal dimension-based adaptive smoothing, allowing the indicator to automatically adjust sensitivity based on market volatility
Supports opposite signal reversal, enabling timely position adjustment when trend direction changes
Provides adaptive lot sizing mode that dynamically scales position size based on account balance
SL/TP modification includes a retry mechanism with up to 7 attempts, improving modification success rate
Trade logic executes only on new bar opening, avoiding redundant per-tick calculations
cons: 仅支持单品种单仓位交易，使用PositionSelect(Symbol())无法处理同品种多单
SL/TP值以点数设置但默认TP远大于SL（3500 vs 500），风险收益比虽好但TP极难触达
止损止盈在开仓后通过修改方式设置而非直接在订单中设置，存在修改失败导致裸仓的风险
close()函数中OrderSend失败后调用GetLastError()但未使用返回值，错误处理形同虚设
自适应手数模式下Max_drawdown参数含义不明确，且未考虑已占用保证金
缺少点差过滤、交易时段限制等基本风控措施
cons_en: Supports only single-symbol single-position trading via PositionSelect(Symbol()), cannot handle multiple positions on the same symbol
Default TP far exceeds SL (3500 vs 500 points), making TP extremely difficult to reach despite favorable risk-reward ratio on paper
SL/TP are set via post-trade modification rather than in the initial order, risking naked positions if modification fails
The close() function calls GetLastError() after OrderSend failure but doesn't use the return value, rendering error handling ineffective
The Max_drawdown parameter meaning is unclear in adaptive lot mode, and available margin is not considered
Lacks basic risk controls such as spread filter, trading session restrictions, or maximum daily loss limits
improvements: 将止损止盈直接在开仓订单中设置（MqlTradeRequest的sl/tp字段），避免修改失败导致的裸仓风险
增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，防止在高点差或低流动性时段开仓
改用订单遍历方式管理仓位而非PositionSelect，以支持多策略同品种并行运行
improvements_en: Set SL/TP directly in the initial order request (MqlTradeRequest sl/tp fields) to avoid naked position risk from modification failures
Add spread filter and trading session controls to prevent opening positions during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Switch from PositionSelect to order iteration for position management to support multiple strategies on the same symbol

risk_points: 止损止盈通过修改方式设置，修改失败则仓位无止损保护
TP设置为SL的7倍，大部分交易可能最终由止损触发而非止盈
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能不利成交
close()函数错误处理不完善，OrderSend失败后未正确记录和处理错误
risk_points_en: SL/TP set via modification after trade; if modification fails, the position has no stop loss protection
TP is set at 7x SL, meaning most trades will likely be stopped out rather than reaching take profit
No spread filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Error handling in close() is incomplete; OrderSend failure is not properly logged or handled
